Delhi CM Launches Green Drive Portal for Tree Plantation

Delhi Chief Minister Rekha Gupta has launched the Green Drive Portal, an initiative aimed at facilitating a mass tree plantation campaign. The portal is also intended to support the restoration of the Ridge Forest. This launch is presented as an update on Delhi's weather and environmental efforts.
